title: McKinsey 4S problem-solving workflow catalog
description: The spine that sequences thinking-toolkit skills + wiki problem-solving concepts into the McKinsey 4S method (State/Structure/Solve/Sell, Cracked it! Ch 3). Capability thinking-toolkit v1.3. Each step binds the OPERATIONS to run (skills) + a curated key-concept reading list + a retrieval recipe so any of the ~230 wiki concepts is findable by step. Structural validity here; file-existence of every referenced skill + concept is enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-mckinsey-workflow.cjs.

source_books.description: Wiki source slugs the concepts are drawn from.

artifacts.description: v1.4: the run-artifact convention (run_folder + the files the engine produces).

data_routing.description: v1.4: analysis-need → data tool routing table (the pull-real-data mechanism).

tool_selection.description: v1.5: the load + select mechanism — CLASSIFY a sub-need (book decision-trees) → LOAD candidates from knowledge/problem-solving-frameworks.yaml (filter by step+type) + resolver_find + wiki_ask → SELECT + COMBINE (latticework + debias). Each entry is a decision lever; concept refs are file-existence-checked by the L2 validator.

validation_gate.description: v1.4: per-datum validation checklist (knock-out, 8-degrees, causation, sensitivity, triangulation, honesty).

routing_rules.description: v1.4: IF→THEN dynamic-routing rules applied after each analysis.

hitl_triggers.description: v1.4: when + how to request data from the user.

composition_guards.description: v1.7: the contract for composing a heavyweight sub-capability (deepask first; deep-research/gbrain share the shape) as a Solve data tool — anti-recursion (one-way layering), cost-valve (knock-out-gated + breaker-aware), evidence-not-decider. Enforced as a non-empty engine section by the L2 validator (concept refs file-checked).

paths.description: v3.1: the 3 problem-solving PATHS of the 4S diagram (Cracked It! Fig 3.1) — hypothesis-driven / issue-driven / design-thinking. Each declares entry_condition (its decision diamond) + band_staging (which 4S band each activity sits in; design-thinking spans State/Structure/Solve). The L2 validator enforces the 3 canonical paths + band ∈ step ids + concept file-existence.

decision_gates.description: v3.1: the 5 decision DIAMONDS of the 4S diagram. Each sits `at` a 4S band, asks the diagram question, and routes yes_route/no_route to a to_step (step id) / to_path (path id) / to_gate (gate id). The L2 validator enforces at ∈ step ids + route targets resolve.

tool_library.description: v3.1: the candidate pool for SELECTION reconciled INTO the spec (closes the gap where the SKILL cited the full v3.0 library but the yaml only referenced the 207-book registry). registries[].count is cross-checked vs the actual registry entry counts by the L2 validator + the coherence validator.

id.description: kebab step id (e.g. state, structure, solve, sell).

order.description: 1-based position in the workflow; must be contiguous + unique.

name.description: Human display name of the step.

bulletproof_7step.description: Cross-map to the Bulletproof Problem Solving 7-step process (finer granularity).

produces.description: v1.4/v1.5/v1.8/v2.0/v3.5: the intermediate artifact(s) this stage emits (from the known artifact set; v1.5 adds 'communication' — the step-7 story, distinct from the step-6 'synthesis' logic; v1.8 adds 'hitl-log' — the HITL receipt ledger; v2.0 adds 'checkpoint-log' — the McKinsey team-session milestone ledger; v3.5 adds 'toolkit-log' — the recorded tool-selection method ledger).

items.description: Skill name (e.g. thinking-toolkit/tosca-problem-framing); must resolve to 06-ai-ops/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

skills.description: The OPERATIONS to run at this step.

book.description: Wiki source slug; must resolve to wiki/<book>/concepts/<slug>.md.

key_concepts.description: Curated starting reading-list of wiki concepts for this step.

query.description: wiki_ask query template to surface MORE concepts for this step on demand.

sources.description: Wiki source slugs to scope the retrieval query to.

retrieval.description: The 'search by catalog later' recipe — how to find any of the ~230 concepts scoped to this step.
